newsitem.title: UK: Metals end mostly lower, LME big stars pressured.
newsitem.headline: Metals end mostly lower, LME big stars pressured.

text.p: COPPER - Closes with trimmed losses but still under $2,500 after profit-taking reaction. Spread backwardation narrows slightly.
NICKEL - Ends above five-month lows and over $7,000, still sharply lower.
ALUMINIUM - Closes easier after technical sell-off. Under $1,600 now.
ZINC/LEAD - Finish with pared losses after modest rallies off lows. TIN - Ends steadier after corrective bounce.
